title: Zion Archive Log Entry
description: Immutable audit record appended to zion.archive.log by every agent action in the system. This durable Kafka commit log is the source of truth / memory for the whole demo ('The Zion Archive').

ref_id.description: ID of the event this archive entry relates to (e.g. reading_id, event_id, or change_id)

summary.description: One human-readable sentence describing the action, LLM-generated where applicable

examples.summary: Flagged a high-severity stability collapse in Subway-Loop-9 and dispatched an orchestration event.
Embedded Trinity's clearance-level update into the oracle-knowledge vector store.
